It states that outdated guidance about shared VPN passwords is invalid, and users should confirm whether the target actually requires VPN, verify MFA and device trust, and check the VPN group as part of troubleshooting. Required ticket fields include employee_id, email, system, business impact, error text, and a screenshot if safe, along with the requested access level if applicable. This article also lists the same required ticket fields and escalation criteria`[cite: [documents/it_kb/okta_device_change.md § (whole document)]]`.
